class.name: vfs_root
class.brief: VFS root object with process path context.
class.details: An overlay file system that accepts absolute or relative paths and owns the current-directory state and backing prefix for one process context. Relative inputs are resolved against its current directory; all inputs are normalized before delegation. Root is an outer entry point and must not be stacked below another root. Path operations reserve a buffer pair before locking metadata. Optional local locking protects CWD copying and commit, and is released before delegated operations and node disposal. When disabled, callers must serialize shared metadata. Each root allocates one CWD buffer on its first successful chdir using the permanent core allocator. The allocation is protected by the metadata mutex and reused for subsequent changes; callers must not replace its pointer. Disposal does not reclaim CWD storage and requires no live nodes or active operations.

field.name: path_cwd
field.brief: Owned CWD storage or @p NULL for root; internal use only.

field.name: path_prefix
field.brief: Normalized absolute prefix for the backing FS or @p NULL.

objinit.param: Pointer to a file system to be overlaid or @p NULL.
Prefix to be added to paths delegated to @p overlaid_fs or @p NULL. Must be a normalized absolute path and remain valid for the lifetime of the root.

method.name: vfsRootOpen
method.brief: Opens a file or directory relative to this root.
method.details: The logical absolute path is resolved once and retained across the file-to-directory fallback, including driver waits. VO_DIRECTORY and trailing separators select directory lookup before file creation or truncation. Invalid flags and empty paths fail before scratch allocation.
method.param: Absolute or relative path of the node to open.
Pointer to the opened node pointer.

method.name: vfsRootChangeCurrentDirectory
method.details: Resolves a candidate, validates it without the metadata lock, then commits. Concurrent successful changes take effect in commit order. The backing namespace may change after validation.
method.param: Absolute or relative path of the new current directory.
